---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G)
  ) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Home Runs per Team-Game by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

## Season comparison

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G)
  ) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = round(total_home_runs / total_team_games, 2)) |>
  arrange(match(yearID, c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)))
```
